include.note: The 252-file source inventory covers compiled/interpreted code plus build/configuration languages, IDE projects, documentation sources, model definition/code-generation inputs, Dockerfile, CMakeLists.txt, and executable extensionless scripts; binaries and ordinary prose/media are not counted. INCLUDE is 67 XBeach runtime Fortran files (all model Fortran in src/xbeach and src/xbeachlibrary except the explicitly demonstrative demo.F90), two Python binding files, scripts/generate.py, params.def, variables.def, RFtable.inp, s.ind, s.inp, and all 27 Mako templates. These generator inputs are source-of-truth model declarations/tables rather than generated output: generate.py says 'Part of the sourcecode of XBeach is autogenerated' and writes .inc files with 'This file is generated by scripts/generate.py'; those BUILT_SOURCES .inc files are absent from this snapshot. Alternative/legacy-looking XBeach-owned modules (including *_new, split wave-boundary, dynamic-library, BMI, and Python binding paths) remain INCLUDE under the ambiguity-default rule. Within the listed dirs, demo/test/build/project/version files remain excluded as itemized below; under trunk/scripts only generate.py is included.

exclude.reason: ftnunit.f90 identifies itself as the 'Module that implements part of the ftnunit framework' and gives a Deltares utils_lgpl SVN HeadURL, so this bundled test framework is not XBeach model code.
The mpich directory convention and bundled COPYRIGHT.rtf attribution to 'Argonne National Laboratory Group' identify these duplicated MPICH headers/examples/project files as vendored MPI software.
netcdf.f90 describes a netCDF Fortran interface and credits 'Robert Pincus' at the University of Wisconsin, while lib/README.txt.txt calls lib a directory of 'prebuild libraries'.
Its header states that it is 'a standard part of the Python distribution', and it sits under the frozen scripts/dist payload.
Their first lines say 'generated automatically by aclocal 1.15.1' and 'Makefile.in generated by automake 1.10 from Makefile.am', respectively.

exclude.group: Autotools/IDE/distribution/build scaffolding outside the generated and vendored groups
exclude.reason: Root essentials labels bootstrap, configure.ac, makedepo.py, Makefile.am, config/ and m4/ as 'Necessary files'; the remaining counted files are likewise confined to build/, project/solution, setup, distribution, formatting, or version-generation paths.
The doc/ path is the documentation tree, and doc/README.manual states 'The XBeach documentation is automatically generated from plain text'; texinfo.tex is its documentation tooling.
